findings: Non-blocking: a stale SQLite dev DB built by create_all has no alembic_version row, so installing alembic afterward would make `alembic upgrade head` try to recreate existing tables and fail. Outside the stated regression (which is the alembic-less path); the tested additive backfill is the safety net. Consider a stamp-on-first-run guard or a one-line doc note.

Non-blocking: the live `alembic upgrade head` / `--autogenerate` run was not executed in verification (no alembic in the venv). Covered by the importorskip-guarded test wherever alembic is installed, plus a hand-reviewed baseline, but not independently confirmed in this environment.
